simple.meaning: properly, to touch the strings or parts of a musical instrument, i.e. play upon it; to make music , accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זָמַר (H2167) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 45 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
